title: WanProfile v1 — one WAN shape as data: every message attempt on a link shaped by this profile takes base_latency_ms plus a uniform draw of up to jitter_ms, is lost with probability loss_rate, and may be retried up to max_attempts times in total with retry_backoff_ms of simulated time between attempts; simulated is always true — a profile is a declared shape for the wind tunnel, never a measurement of a real network (Y-063)
